title: Hot Chocolate (Dry Mix, Reduced Sugar, Non-Dairy Milk)

content.title: About
content.content: A dry mix for hot chocolate with reduced sugar, made with non‑dairy milk (soy, oat or almond). The mix dissolves easily in hot water or plant‑based milk, creating a rich, aromatic beverage with a smooth chocolate flavor without any dairy ingredients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix contains cocoa mass enriched with plant protein, making it more nutritious than traditional powders.
Sugar reduction is achieved with stevia and erythritol, which do not raise blood glucose levels.
Non‑dairy milk provides natural vitamin D and calcium, often added through fortification.
The dry form allows storage for up to 12 months without loss of flavor or aroma.
Lactose‑free hot chocolate is suitable for vegans and people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa is high in flavonoids, which help combat free radicals and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Reduced sugar and natural sweeteners prevent sharp spikes in blood glucose.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Fortified plant milk adds protein that aids muscle recovery and promotes satiety.

items.title: Supports bone health
items.content: Calcium and vitamin D fortification help maintain strong bones, especially important for vegans.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Absence of lactose makes the drink suitable for those with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: The product may contain soy, oat or almond; individuals with allergies should check the label.

items.title: Sensitivity to sweeteners
items.content: Some people may experience mild gastrointestinal discomfort from stevia or erythritol.

items.title: Caffeine content
items.content: Cocoa contains a small amount of theobromine, which can affect sleep if consumed in large quantities.

items.title: Calorie increase with rich milk
items.content: Preparing the drink with full‑fat plant milk can raise the overall calorie count.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 2‑3 tablespoons of the dry mix into 250 ml of hot water or plant‑based milk, whisk until smooth. Optionally add a pinch of cinnamon, vanilla, or a small amount of plant‑based butter for extra creaminess.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry mix in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 3‑4 months.
